cvvTarget: the second iframe[src*='cybersource'] under Card Details:input[aria-label='Card security code']
gotchas: www.advanceautoparts.com redirects to shop.advanceautoparts.com, and search, product pages, the cart, checkout and the card frames all stay on shop. Open the home page first and wait about 8 seconds before typing, because that load sets the guest region and zip cookies and an earlier fill times out.

Search is input[aria-label='Enter search text']; input[type=search] counts 0. Results take about 12 seconds and are a[href*='/p/'] links. Do not use the legacy /web/SearchResults path, which serves a down-for-maintenance page.

The product page asks how you want to get the item before it will add anything. Three tiles read Store Pickup, Same Day Home Delivery and Home Delivery, and only the third needs no store. Click it with exact text, *:has(> [role=group]:has(p:text-is('Home Delivery'))), which counts 1. The looser p:has-text('Home Delivery') counts 2 because the middle tile contains the same phrase, and every loose match lands on that store-gated tile while still reporting a successful click. There is no radio input on the tiles.

With no fulfillment tile selected the add is accepted but dropped, an inline alert reads First Select Store Pickup or Delivery Method, and the cart reads CART EMPTY. That alert is the cheap way to tell whether a tile selector actually worked.

Never click Choose a Store on the product page. The store modal makes the background inert and every later click on the page times out for the rest of the run. It is also unnecessary, because the Home Delivery tile is store free. The tell is that accessible names vanish from the page, since the inert background drops out of the accessibility tree.
The header cart button click timed out in every run that reached it. Press Enter on button[aria-label='cartButton'] instead, then wait about 11 seconds.
Guest is the default at checkout and there is no account wall. Sign In is an optional button and there is no Continue as Guest control to find.
The contact step has a single phone box, so a phone value goes in whole. Continue stays disabled until the email and the phone validate.
input[name*='ddress' i] counts 2 on the delivery step, the address combobox plus Apt or Unit, and a fill lands on the combobox. Standard delivery is preselected, so the delivery speed needs no click.

The State field is a custom combobox whose listbox renders one empty item and no options. A value fill, a plain click and a literal text fill all timed out and Continue stays disabled, so the delivery address is never saved. Untried and worth trying first: click the wrapper *:has(> input[name*='state' i]) or the Choose a State label to open the list before typing.

The Payment accordion renders expanded before the delivery step is complete, which is why the card fields are reachable while State still blocks Continue. Add Credit or Debit Card is preselected and PayPal is the alternative.

Card number and security code are two sibling CyberSource Microform iframes; iframe[src*='cybersource'] counts 2, the first holding the card number and the second the security code. Parent-scope the frame locator to tell them apart. Expiry is an inline input in the main document at input[aria-label='expiry'].
No working order-total selector was found: [class*='orderTotal' i] and [data-testid*='total' i] never resolved. The Order Total row is readable as text on both the cart and the checkout page.
notes: Driven through the Agent Vault proxy in September 2026 from the home page to the CyberSource card-number iframe on shop.advanceautoparts.com: search, product page, the Home Delivery tile, add to cart, the cart, CHECKOUT NOW, the contact step with email and phone, then the delivery address fields. The card was not filled, so the status is unverified. Two things stay unmapped, the State combobox that blocks the delivery step from saving and a usable order-total selector. The local runs settle nothing either way, because the edge answers every page from that egress with an empty 200 document.
